review:
Book of Faith is a Wazdan book slot with a twist. In Free Spins, the expanding symbol fills whole reels like you'd expect, but then it shape-shifts into Bonus Cash symbols that Collectors above the reels can pick up.

Collect to Infinity is the big one: land it below a Collector and that Collector keeps gathering prizes for the rest of the bonus. Together, those features take the max win to 5,000x. Chance Level lets you multiply your bet up to 6x to reach Free Spins more often. High volatility, 96.13% RTP. Its soundtrack won silver at the CasinoBeats Game Developer Awards 2024, so keep the sound on. Try the Book of Faith demo free to see the expanded symbols turn into cash.
